description: Skill catalog for the specweave plugin. The skills are generated from skills/sw-<name>/ and skills/catalog.json (scripts/build/generate-skills.mjs): core skills in skills/, optional ones in skills-optional/, installed per project by specweave skills enable or detection. The plugin version is tracked in .claude-plugin/plugin.json.

skills.name: sw:increment
skills.description: Settle the user's critical decisions, then plan a unit of work: one spec.md with Problem, Scope, numbered ACs, Approach, Decisions and Tasks. Replaces brainstorm.

skills.name: sw:grill-me
skills.description: Interview the user in rounds until every decision in a plan is settled; records Decisions in spec.md.

skills.name: sw:do
skills.description: Work the increment task by task through the ledger, alone, unattended or in parallel lanes: task next, claim, implement, commit, task done with evidence. Replaces team.

skills.name: sw:auto
skills.description: User-invoked entry to sw:do unattended mode: run an increment until every task is done, then verify and close.

skills.name: sw:done
skills.description: Close an increment: board check, specweave verify, fresh-context review, specweave complete.

skills.name: sw:review
skills.description: Adversarial review by a fresh context or another model family (specweave review); every finding cites path:line and is re-verified. Replaces qa, code-reviewer and judge-llm.

skills.name: sw:handoff
skills.description: "Hand off" in one tool, "pick up" in any other tool, account or machine: specweave handoff and specweave pickup.

skills.name: sw:glossary
skills.description: Build GLOSSARY.md: each domain term across business, data, code and UI; specweave glossary check finds drift.

skills.name: sw:sync
skills.description: One sync surface for GitHub, Jira and Azure DevOps: push, pull, status, setup. Replaces the per-provider sync, mapper, validator and import skills.

skills.name: sw:project
skills.description: Shared goal, memory, work items, artifacts and briefs, portable across AI tools and accounts.

skills.name: sw:jev
skills.description: Delegate closed-set decisions to Jev (TypeSafe System One) instead of a frontier turn: routing, command safety, text screening, failure triage.

optionalSkills.note: Shipped in plugins/specweave/skills-optional/, not loaded by the plugin. A project turns one on with: specweave skills enable <name>

removedIn2_0.note: Removed in 2.0. Use the replacement; there is no alias routing.

removedIn3_0.note: Removed in 3.0. Use the replacement; there is no alias routing.

removedIn3_1.note: Removed in 3.1. Use the replacement; there is no alias routing.

map.skills-optional/e2e: sw:do (check each AC end to end)
